audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 2, 3 and 4 were given to Gwen while their own explanations say the opposite — 'Level 3 evens out', 'through 4-5 it stays skill-based', 'at 6 the ult trade is even'.
audit.why: The packet chart reads Skill, Gwen, Skill, Skill, Skill, Gwen, Vladimir at 54.22%, which matches the prose exactly: she owns level 2 and her first-item on-hit spike, the rest is decided by Mist uptime, and you take the late game.
audit.corrected: Rows 2, 3 and 4 flipped to Skill as matched win[N] + phases[N].side pairs, with the two low ratings rescaled.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hallowed Mist is named the matchup-defining cooldown on four different fields and never once carries a number.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist is 22/21/20/19/18 — barely shorter as it ranks up, so the window you get for baiting it stays roughly the same all lane. Snip Snip! is 6.5s down to 3.5s, and Skip 'n Slash refunds part of its 13s cooldown when she hits something.
audit.corrected: The 22s figure written into spikes[0].text, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page said Mist makes her 'untouchable' without stating the actual rule, and never mentioned that Snip Snip! deals true damage in the centre of the cone.
audit.why: Riot's text: Hallowed Mist 'protects her from enemies outside of it. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist' — so your targeted Transfusion is refused unless you stand in it, which is a decision you can make, not a wall. And Snip Snip! 'deals true damage to units in the center', so resistances are the wrong answer to her core poke.
audit.corrected: Written into spikes[0].text, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and dontsFull[1].d.

audit.why: A Thousand Cuts heals her off champion damage, and report[8].t already makes anti-heal core. Mercury's Treads is right against Needlework's slows.

edits.before: Gwen's Snip Snip! (Q) out-pokes you and her Hallowed Mist (W) makes her untouchable to your Transfusion inside the cloud, so she farms safely and trades on her terms — but with no W up you can burst her with E-Q.
edits.after: Gwen's Snip Snip! (Q) deals true damage down the centre, and inside Hallowed Mist (W) only enemies standing in the cloud can target her — your Transfusion cannot reach. Mist is 22s at rank 1: burst her with E-Q in that gap.

edits.before: She’s safe inside. Poke when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Only enemies inside the mist can target her — 22s, so wait it out.

edits.before: Track Gwen's Hallowed Mist: She’s safe inside. Poke when down. When it is down — Q-E + R her.
edits.after: Hallowed Mist (W), 22s at rank 1: only enemies inside can target her. Q-E-R in the gap.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: A Thousand Cuts scales off your health and her Q centre is true.

notes: The packet suspect name 'Snip Snip' is a near-miss on 'Snip Snip!' — the page writes it correctly with the exclamation mark everywhere I checked, so it is a FALSE POSITIVE. Crimson Pact does convert AP into bonus health, so the mirror's point stands: your health total feeds A Thousand Cuts and Grievous Wounds, not raw resistances, is the answer to her sustain.
